Subject: Deployment & data residency follow-up - NordBank

Hi Signe -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick post-call recap and next steps so we all have the same picture:

Summary of NordBank needs (from our call)
- Primary requirement: full EU data residency for customer data and logs (required for regulated workloads).
- Preference: Private VPC or on-prem package for primary production workloads; interested in Hosted API for pilot/non-sensitive workflows.
- Region availability: prefer eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) or eu-west-1 (Ireland); want to avoid cross-border transfer to US unless explicitly DR/failover.
- DR and routing: need an option for cross-region failover (EU -> APAC/US) for disaster recovery while ensuring data-at-rest stays in EU under normal operation.
- Latency SLA: target P95 < 100ms for inference calls from EU production traffic.
- Compliance: SOC 2 + customer-managed KMS/HSM for key control and support for audit data export.

Attachments I included: region-availability-matrix.pdf, private-deployment-checklist.xlsx - these contain our current region map and a checklist for Private deployments.

Immediate next steps (requested)
1) We will confirm which EU regions are currently available for Hosted and Dedicated and which require a Private deployment.
2) Marissa will scope compliance assumptions for Private VPC (KMS options, audit logs, and evidence).
3) Propose a technical deep-dive next week with Aditya + your infra/security team to go over network egress, S3/log routing, and latency testing.

Proposed times: Tue 21 Mar 09:00-10:00 CET or Wed 22 Mar 14:00-15:00 CET - let me know what works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

If useful, I can also outline a short pilot plan: Hosted EU-only for low-risk flows for 2-4 weeks, then a staged migration to Private VPC for production.

Thanks - talk soon.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments - very helpful. A couple of clarifying questions from the infra/procurement side before we lock a slot for the deep-dive:

1) Hosted regions: can you confirm exactly which AWS regions are available for Hosted API with EU-only data residency guarantees? We have strict rules about data leaving eu-west-1/eu-central-1.
2) Logs & metrics: is it possible to push audit logs and metrics to a customer-managed S3 in our EU account (S3 bucket controlled by us), or do logs always route back to Redwood-managed storage?
3) Latency: you mentioned P95 < 100ms - is that achievable from our primary Frankfurt region with a Hosted setup, or would Dedicated/Private be required for that SLA?
4) KMS/HSM: for Private VPC, can we bring our own KMS or HSM for encryption keys?

We’re aiming to have procurement and infra aligned by the end of next week. If you can reply to the questions above, we’ll prioritize the deep-dive invite.

Subject: Re: Deployment & data residency follow-up - NordBank

Hi Signe -

Answers inline below:

1) Hosted regions (EU): we currently offer Hosted API with EU-only data residency controls in eu-west-1 (Ireland) and eu-central-1 (Frankfurt). Both regions support data-at-rest and token handling confined to the region when configured as EU-only. Note: for cross-region failover we can configure DR to a secondary region, but that path is opt-in and must be documented in the runbook.

2) Logs & metrics: yes - for Private VPC and Dedicated we can configure log export to a customer-managed S3 in your account (we support IAM role-based write to your bucket). For Hosted accounts, standard audit logs are retained in Redwood-managed control plane; however we offer a log-forwarding add-on that can deliver logs (audit + usage) to a customer S3 via a secure, region-restricted pipeline. We included the export options and expected retention in the attached checklist.

3) Latency: typical P95 for inference from EU regions on Hosted is ~50-80ms for small-medium models under normal traffic. For sustained high throughput with guaranteed P95 <100ms at scale, Dedicated reserved capacity is the recommended path. Private VPC can meet latency goals as well, especially when colocated close to your VPC endpoints - we’ll validate during the technical deep-dive with a short perf test.

4) KMS/HSM: yes - Private VPC supports customer-managed KMS keys (BYOK) and we have options to integrate with customer HSM providers in on-prem deployments. We will include a KMS integration checklist in the technical call.

Next step: Aditya and Marissa will join the deep-dive to cover network routing, perf testing, and compliance artifacts. Can you confirm whether Tue 21 Mar 09:00-10:00 CET works? If so I’ll send the calendar invite and include a short agenda + perf test plan.

Regards,
Lauren
